title: Improved Research Paper: Leveraging AI for Enhancing Lung Cancer Detection
content: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide, with late-stage diagnoses contributing significantly to high mortality rates. Early and accurate detection is crucial for improving survival rates and treatment outcomes. Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), offer exceptional promise in aiding lung cancer detection through advanced data analysis. This paper explores the potential of AI in enhancing lung cancer detection processes, including image analysis, risk prediction, and workflow optimization. By leveraging AI-driven methodologies, healthcare professionals can improve diagnostic accuracy, streamline operations, and ultimately enhance patient care.
